scope: Independent source review of nanosecond elapsed conversion, exact OS CPU arithmetic order and Linux KiB-to-bytes RSS. Separate parent/worker peaks are never summed.

Original three-case requests, unmodified input, same-byte official coordinates and geometry, installed identity, actual process relation, isolated command/environment and original raw/log SHA are rechecked.

Fresh waited-child usage and returned/reaped worker are required; 18 sequential fresh drivers, 3 excluded warmups and 15 measured samples. Median and nearest-rank p95 for five samples correctly use the fifth/max sample.

Strict embedded JSON and typed worker PID/exit guards are present. Existing two owner methods meaningfully reject changed metrics, reused child accounting, invalid geometry, boolean worker PID and a missing sample.
limitations: Linux current host measurements, no Windows performance claim, hard resource quota or whole-project validation.
Review uses existing actual positive/targeted logs without repeating layout/capture or redundant mutation checks. Historical execution is not authenticated.
